summary: Fixed Nora sometimes getting permanently stuck unable to rejoin a Discord voice channel until restarted.
details: Discord's voice server can silently drop an idle voice connection on its own. When Nora's idle-timeout (or /music stop) then tried to disconnect that already-dead connection, discord.py's default graceful disconnect returned early without ever unregistering the guild's voice client -- leaving that guild permanently "already connected" from discord.py's own point of view, blocking every future play request with no live player or audio to show for it.
The disconnect now forces cleanup regardless of whether the remote side already dropped the connection, since it only ever runs because Nora herself decided the session is over.
